title: fix(scripts): refuse PR-only labels on a new issue in issue-create
body:

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbNKXM3PyX5W136u8jKBiA5Q)_

Fixes #31359

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:建卡脚本 `issue-create.mjs` 在发出任何写入之前,先用 `label-write.mjs` 导出的同一条种类规则检查 `--label`;给新 issue 挂只属于 PR 的 `pm:awaiting-merge`(任意大小写)会被拒绝,干跑同样拒绝。
- 为什么改:种类规则此前只守在中继的命令行入口,建卡脚本直接调用 `sendFleetWrite` 绕了过去,PR 专用标签仍能落到新卡上。
- 风险与回滚:只动一个仓内工具脚本,不发布任何包;回滚即还原该文件这一处调用与一条自测。
- 先看:`scripts/pm/issue-create.mjs` 的 `planFrom` 里 `refuseKindLabels` 那三行,其次是干跑电池新增的那条自测。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/issue-create.mjs --self-test`,预期 65 条全过;再带 `--dry-run --label PM:AWAITING-MERGE` 跑一次,预期退出码 2 并引出规则原文。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `scripts/pm/issue-create.mjs` imports `refuseKindLabels`, `KIND_ISSUE` and `KIND_RULE_AWAITING_MERGE_PR_ONLY` from `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs` (no rule retyped; no import cycle, the file already imported `classifyHttp` from there).
- `planFrom` asks `refuseKindLabels({ kind: KIND_ISSUE, add: labels, ref: 'the new card' })` right after the existing `rewriteRetiredLaneLabels` call. A refusal joins the plan's errors, so `main` prints the rule and exits 2 (usage) before any transport is chosen: dry run, direct POST and relay alike.
- Header gains a short "The kind rule" section; the dry-run battery pin moves 3 to 4.
- `close-cards.mjs` untouched, as the card says.

## Tests

- New self-test case (dry-run battery): `--dry-run --label PM:AWAITING-MERGE` exits 2, stderr carries the quoted rule, nothing is printed as sent, nothing is paced. Self-test 65/65 at the final head (was 64/64 on main).
- Ablation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete` of the `if (wrongKind) errors.push(wrongKind);` line: anchor 1 to 0 on disk, self-test exit 1 with exactly that case red (got exit 0, rule not quoted, plan printed as sent); restored, blob hash equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Manual: the uppercase label prints the rule plus the case-insensitive note and exits 2; control `--label pm:queue` dry run exits 0.

## Acceptance notes

- None.

## Verification

- `dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate, 18 changed lines.
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 32 derived families, all exit 0 at 7372117a; `--ran` reconciles 32 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. The merge of main (deac7f46) brought no file under `scripts/`; the same 32 were rerun at the merge head 17ed0b18, all exit 0, `--ran` 32 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
